broad_review: Broad unblinded review covered fixed samples 00/01 for all 151 classes, six samples in preselected Eevee/Gyarados/Metapod panels, and the A3 confirmation gallery. Both arms retain many class cues and distinct compositions, with substantial structural failures. A3 often simplifies anatomy or changes features; examples include Gyarados, Lapras, Scyther, Squirtle and Metapod. Some individual outputs have clearer contours, but the full comparison does not show a uniform semantic advantage. The higher A3 pixel-diversity summary does not establish greater semantic coverage. Pixel flags are 0/151 in both final draws; near-memorization is not ruled out by pixel neighbors.
interpretation: A3 improves strongly late in training but remains worse than S3 at all three matched checkpoints and the confirmation seed. This continues the two-call disadvantage in this finite single-training-realization pilot.
